articles.title: Nirmal Purja: Ex-Royal Marine among 10 climbers feared missing after avalanche in Pakistan - BBC
articles.description: An American, a Chinese national, an Omani and five Nepalis are said to be part of the group feared missing in Pakistan.
articles.content: An American, a Chinese national, a Pakistani, an Omani and six Nepalis are said to be part of the climbing group, according to the Alpine Club of Pakistan.
